description: This file defines a ViewModel class for a calculator dashboard UI. It manages LiveData for errors, calculation results, and performs validation and arithmetic operations based on user input.

classes.name: DashboardViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel for managing calculator operations, errors, and result display in the dashboard UI.

methods.name: onOperation
methods.description: Performs an arithmetic operation after validating input numbers; updates the result or error messages.

methods.name: onClear
methods.description: Resets all error messages and the displayed result to their initial states.
